title: postmark-mcp backdoored to blind-copy every agent-sent email
summary: The npm package postmark-mcp, an MCP server that lets AI assistants send mail through Postmark, added a hidden BCC recipient in version 1.0.16 so that every message an agent sent was copied to an attacker-controlled address. Koi Security reported it on 25 September 2025 and the package was removed from npm.
severity_rationale: Silent exfiltration of all agent-sent mail including password resets, limited by an install base of roughly 1,600 downloads and prompt removal.
